note.question: How do minmax and maxmin solutions interact?
note.overview: Min-max or max-min objective criteria naturally arise in many resource allocation applications, especially when the attendant goal involves distribution of a limited resource across multiple subsystems, locations, or activities. Each has a different consumption rate of the resource. In this setting, the decision maker is interested in optimizing the system performance, which can be measured in terms of the smallest or largest order statistic across subsystems.
